newsitem.title: USA: Green Mountain gets Coffee Station pact.
newsitem.headline: Green Mountain gets Coffee Station pact.

text.p: Coffee Station Inc chose Green Mountain Coffee Inc as its exclusive coffee supplier, Green Mountain said Monday.
Coffee Station Inc will offer Green Mountain Coffee Roasters branded coffee in all of its locations by March 1 1997.
Coffee Station, a specialty coffee retailer with 25 locations nationwide, opened its first store in 1994 and currently has 25 locations.

Green Mountain Coffee produces more than 70 varieties of coffee that it sells under the Green Mountain Coffee Roasters and Green Mountain Coffee brands. Green Mountain's sales increased 145 percent during the three years ended September 28, 1996.
